related_questions.question: Does the Child Tax Credit affect your tax return?
related_questions.snippet: The Child Tax Credit is a federal support program for Americans who are raising kids. Claiming the credit lowers your tax bill by up to $2,000 per qualifying child under age 17 who is under your care. So if you owe $2,000 in federal income tax and qualify for a credit worth $2,000, your tax bill could be wiped out.
